bias.en: Turning bullish · rejected above the 100-day, back to the 10 and 30-day
bias.zh: 转多中 · 在 100 日均线上方受阻，回落至 10 日和 30 日均线

read.en: Rockwell fell 3.4% on Oct 30 to $436.20 (range $432.81–450.50) after a 1.7% gain on Oct 29. It is below the rising 5-day ($440.10) and falling 100-day ($446.06), and above the rising 10-day ($434.12), 30-day ($434.69) and 200-day ($427.07). MACD has been above its signal since Oct 27 and above zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Oct 27 ($416.83), and RSI is 51.
read.zh: 罗克韦尔 10月30日下跌 3.4%，收于 $436.20（区间 $432.81–450.50），此前 10月29日上涨 1.7%。股价低于上行的 5 日均线（$440.10）和下行的 100 日均线（$446.06），高于上行的 10 日（$434.12）、30 日（$434.69）和 200 日均线（$427.07）。MACD 自 10月27日起位于信号线上方且在零轴之上，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月27日起看多（$416.83），RSI 为 51。

read.en: Oct 29 closed above the 100-day at $451.40, but Oct 30 reversed below it and broke the $441.4 support, now resistance. Resistance is $440.1–441.4 (5-day, Oct 21 high), then $446.1–446.7 (100-day, Oct 28 high) and $450.5–452.4 (Oct 29–30 highs). Support is $432.8–434.7 (10 and 30-day, Oct 30 low), then $427.1 (200-day) and $416.8–417.6 (SAR, Oct 22 low). A close above $446.7 would target $452–455; below $432.8, $427.
